decision: Main V3 data/print/topology findings addressed in source; missing-unit focus displacement requires repair or targeted proof before integration. No runtime approval or whole159 acceptance.
source_verified: Board WeakMap refresher updates captured postings/cards/rows and reuses existing input/print/focus listeners; cleanup deletes only matching binding and disconnects old listener owner.

Print refresh releases old restore closure before fresh apply, then captures fresh normal nodes/materializes matching full rows when print media remains active; old table snapshot no longer survives that path.

Missing returned unit replaces modal displayed totals/validation/members with unavailable wording, retains actual settings form/input nodes, marks customValidity and throws into existing GET-only recovery instead of announcing successful refresh.
Returned unit clears only unit-missing validity markers, updates call bounds/counts by exact calllevel identity, retains user input values; stillmissing call gets its own invalid/reopen notice.

Helper snapshots dirty state before readback painting and extends prior baseline only with server-added call rows. Existing user changed fields remain dirty; server-added rows alone no longer imply user unsaved edits.
Present-unit header focus captured before nav disable; exact dataattributes/text recover owned displaced editor/validation action or status.

remaining_findings.finding: Missing-unit branch captures active focus but returns via throw without recovery for focus inside replaced validation/member regions or newly disabled nav.
remaining_findings.direction: Capture whether original active target is invalidated; focus explicit unavailable notice/status only when that target was owned and is now BODY/disconnected/disabled, never steal from current input/another native dialog.
